summary: Repointed T103's current-evidence references from T109 to T112 manifest and paired simulation-evidence; preserved T109 as historical read-only predecessor; explicitly marked pre-T103 T069/T105/T063 manifests as historical; kept T103 depends_on as [T085, T102, T110] (T112 is inherited transitively through T110 per A0035); preserved the Must-not block byte-identical with no weakening; added a References sentence noting T112 is the current registry-bound source and T109 is preserved as predecessor history. todo/config.yaml was not modified.
rationale: T112 is DELIVERED (APPROVED, replaces=[T109]) and is the documented current registry-bound product-run evidence source per A0026 impact A0026:T103:research-entry-and-market-page. T103 is an indirect consumer of T109 (through T085, T102 and T110) rather than a direct consumer; T110 already binds T112 directly via A0035, so T103 inherits the T112 edge transitively through that existing contract and does not need its own depends_on extension in todo/config.yaml. The Owner direction in amendment-request.json explicitly forbids editing todo/config.yaml for this amendment and explicitly forbids adding T112 to T103 Dependencies. The T103 contract therefore only swaps current-evidence language in Deliverables, Acceptance and References from T109 dataset-addressed / run entry / MarketState / manifest to T112 manifest and paired simulation-evidence; marks pre-T103 T069/T105/T063 manifests as historical read-only predecessor artifacts never parsed as current evidence; preserves the byte-identical Must-not block including its duplicate-fee / second-replay / strategy-code-in-market / exact-run-fabrication bans. No business code, no workflow state, no Intent/Spec, no plan-structure revision, no T069/T105/T063 contract, and no other task contract is touched.

impact_assessment.intent: Not applicable. PROJECT_GOALS.md and the broader docs/intent/ surface are unchanged. A0042 operates only on a still-PLANNED P10 task contract that was naming a downstream T1xx sibling as its current evidence source for the research pages. No product-intent question is reopened by repointing which T1xx sibling supplies T103's current evidence; the four research pages still have to teach, validate and bind to a current registry-bound source, just as the pages already do under T087/T088.
impact_assessment.specification: Not applicable. docs/spec/product/WEB_CONSOLE.md (the WEB-PAGE-008/009/010/011 and WEB-GLOBAL-* spec pages T103 implements), docs/spec/research/DATASET_AND_EVALUATION.md, docs/spec/strategy/LP_METRICS.md, docs/spec/architecture/ARCHITECTURE.md and the rest of docs/spec/ are unchanged. The current-evidence source naming in T103 is a contract-level binding, not a Spec statement. The Spec-level cutover from T109 to T112 was already recorded by the spec_revision v1-2026-09-23-a0026-run-evidence-cutover accompanying T112; the four research pages still have to read a current registry-bound manifest and paired simulation-evidence source as that Spec already requires.
impact_assessment.contracts: Applicable: todo/phases/P10-research-and-models/T103.md is the only contract edited. Its Dependencies line remains 'T085, T102, T110' (no T112 edge is added in this amendment; T112 is reachable transitively through T110 per A0035, per Owner direction). The Deliverables retarget: 'T109's dataset-addressed MarketState' to 'T112's dataset-addressed MarketState' (WEB-PAGE-009 inspector); 'T109 run entry point' to 'T112 run entry point' (model laboratory training/evaluation trigger). The Acceptance retarget: 'WEB-PAGE-009 returns T109 MarketState' to 'WEB-PAGE-009 returns T112 MarketState'; 'neither this page nor T109 contains a second fee implementation' to 'neither this page nor T112 contains a second fee implementation'; 'submits through the T109 entry point' to 'submits through the T112 entry point'. The References retarget: 'T109 (the current run entry point every training or evaluation trigger submits through and the market-only MarketState authority)' is split into 'T112 (the current registry-bound manifest and paired simulation-evidence source every training or evaluation trigger submits through and the dataset-addressed market-only MarketState authority this page renders)' and 'T109 (historical read-only predecessor manifest and simulation-evidence pending the SUPERSEDE amendment; T069, T105 and T063 remain predecessor history and a pre-T103 T069/T105/T063 manifest, if encountered, is preserved read-only and never parsed as current evidence on any page this task owns)'; and a new References sentence is appended noting 'T112 is the current registry-bound source of manifest and paired simulation-evidence this task consumes; T109 is preserved only as a historical read-only predecessor and is not the current evidence source'. The Must-not block (lines 91-100) is preserved byte-identical with no weakening; its duplicate-fee / second-replay / strategy-code-in-market / exact-run-fabrication / provenance-binding bans remain binding. No other task contract is touched (T069, T105, T063, T084, T087, T088, T110, T112 are unchanged).
impact_assessment.dependencies: Not applicable. todo/config.yaml is not modified by this amendment, per Owner direction. T103.depends_on remains [T085, T102, T110] (matches the contract's Dependencies line). T112 is reachable transitively from T103 through T110 (T110.depends_on already contains T112 per A0035), so the dependency DAG is not broken and no PLANNED direct consumer needs re-pointing for T103. The phase/active_task/workflow_state/intent_revision/spec_revision/agent_runtime top-level fields remain unchanged. No other task record's depends_on, replaces, superseded_by, lifecycle, claimed, attempt, base_commit, candidate_commit, approved_commit, latest_review or task_file field is touched.
impact_assessment.implementation: Not applicable. No business code is authored, modified, tested, reviewed or shipped. The T103 contract remains PLANNED with attempt=0 and no candidate or approved commit; no implementation gate is opened or closed. The Developer on a future T103 attempt will follow the updated contract and consume T112 manifest and paired simulation-evidence through T110's ReplayFrame surface. The T109 contract's defective fixed-empty-source / fabricated-reference writer remains non-current for new runs under T112's runtime cutover clause and stays reachable only through the T069 entry for historical read-only / test fixture use, exactly as recorded by A0040 and the T112 review.
impact_assessment.data: Not applicable. No persisted artifact is created, modified, migrated, or reinterpreted. The amendment changes only which T1xx sibling T103 names as the current authority for the on-disk evidence and MarketState; it does not move, copy, rewrite or relocate any manifest, report, simulation-evidence, dataset partition, dataset hash, run record on disk. Historical T069/T105/T063/T109 results and manifests stay byte-identical and read-only through the versioned legacy reader; only their rendering as historical is called out explicitly in the References pre-T103 clause.
impact_assessment.operations: Not applicable. No runtime surface, CLI command, background process, replay path, lifecycle hook, restart behaviour or live-process contract is touched. T112's runtime cutover remains gated by T112's atomic-publication clause and by the reviewed SUPERSEDE amendment that will annotate T109 superseded_by T112; this amendment neither enables that cutover nor alters the fail-closed behaviour T103's contract requires (an absent or non-validated evidence artifact already renders WEB-GLOBAL-002 unknown / fail-closed with a named reason on every page this task owns). Browser restart semantics, deployment, and any signer/testnet/live authority concerns remain out of scope.
impact_assessment.security: Not applicable. T103's four research pages (WEB-PAGE-008/009/010/011) remain read-only with no execution-approval surface; the page contracts explicitly ban 'let a dataset or model definition become an execution approval or appear in an execution-shaped control' in the preserved byte-identical Must-not block. No secret handling, authentication, signing, signer memory, keystore, wallet control, signing payload, endpoint secret, webhook credential, .env value or authorization-header surface is altered. T112 manifest and paired simulation-evidence carry no private key, signing payload, endpoint secret or credential by contract.
impact_assessment.verification: Applicable at the contract-and-config drift level only: this amendment edits exactly one contract file (T103.md) and does not touch todo/config.yaml, so the controller's drift check at finish-amendment will see the T103 Dependencies line ('T085, T102, T110') agree with todo/config.yaml's T103.depends_on field, with no T112 edge required in either surface for this amendment. No test, golden, fixture, oracle, tolerance or acceptance criterion is added, removed or relaxed; the existing T103 Acceptance clauses (WEB-PAGE-008/009/010/011 component/API mapping, coverage-absent-not-interpolated, dataset save/reproduce, backtest-support-level gating, model-diagnostics-with-economic-verdict pairing, regime/time-slice episode counts, RELATIVE_ONLY distinction, read-path no-mutation, WEB-PAGE-013 non-substitution, WEB-PAGE-009 MarketState direct T040/T041 equivalence, hypothetical overlay never RunState/ReplayFrame/exact-run, every fee/range-fee equals direct T104 with matching provenance, no-second-fee inspection against the current authority, dataset hash/PoolKey/cursor/range/revision fail-closed, no-ad-hoc-second-replay architecture test, training/evaluation trigger submits through the current entry-point and displays the same run identity/status/progress/failure/cancellation, boundary cases for partial coverage / out-of-range replay / superseded training dataset / demoted pool / unavailable background service) remain the binding verification gate when T103 is eventually implemented. T103 itself does not re-test the T112 pipeline-repair invariants (real T100 partition resolution, block_range vs tick_range separation, fill-cursor preservation); those continue to be exercised by T112's own acceptance matrix.
